fact_text: The government planned an Ijara sukuk issue of about 90 billion PKR to be raised over December 2023 to February 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: The one-year Ijara sukuk was described as offering a return of about 20 to 22 percent.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: The sukuk auctions were scheduled for 8 Dec 2023, 23 Jan 2024 and 20 Feb 2024.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: Sukuk differ from T-bills and plain bonds because each is backed by an underlying asset, such as an airport or a motorway, so it is not just a commercial paper.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: The analyst said the government needs funds as the budget deficit widens and the fiscal responsibility law is breached, and it cannot keep borrowing expensively from commercial banks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: The analyst wanted the sukuk traded on the stock exchange so brokers can deal in it, rather than only on broker terminals.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: The Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund was described as about 7.8 billion USD in size, part of which has not yet been realised.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: OGDC's stake has been placed in the Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: PPL's stake has been placed in the Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund.

fact_text: Mari Petroleum's stake has been placed in the Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund.

fact_text: National Bank's stake has been placed in the Pakistan Sovereign Wealth Fund.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: National Bank was trading at about 2.3 times book value, a discount to peers, as of this review.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: The analyst linked National Bank's discount to peers to years without dividends, which in turn stem from a Supreme Court case over netting off pension and gratuity dues.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: The analyst said that if the pension and gratuity amounts, put at about 50 billion PKR in the accounts he checked, can be netted off, National Bank could resume dividends like its peers.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)

fact_text: UBL pays a dividend of about 1 PKR per share every quarter, which the analyst cited when comparing bank payouts.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'Sukuk Bond Issue Impact on PSX Market Insights' (YouTube, 2023-12-08)
